description: Return the complete publication-order book list for a book series — the order the author released them, including novellas and companion volumes where cataloged. Use this when a user asks 'what order do I read John Grisham?', 'Harry Potter books in order', or how many books a series has. Accepts a series or author name ('Jack Reacher', 'Brandon Sanderson').

series.description: Series or author name, e.g. 'Jack Reacher' or 'John Grisham'

name: get_series_reading_order
title: Get a series' reading order
